citations.quote: Name: Quinn. Official role tags: Marksman, Assassin.

core_mechanics.summary: Quinn is a marksman and assassin.

citations.quote: Quinn's next basic attack against a Harrier target consumes the mark to deal bonus physical damage.
Quinn and Valor team up to fly around at great speed.

core_mechanics.summary: Marked attacks deal bonus physical damage, while Valor enables fast travel.

purpose: Recognize Quinn's fighting pattern and roaming threat.
title: Quinn

citations.quote: While Behind Enemy Lines is active, Harrier is disabled and all Harrier marks are removed.

advanced_exceptions.summary: Harrier is disabled and existing marks are removed during Behind Enemy Lines.

citations.quote: Periodically, Valor marks a nearby enemy with Harrier.
Quinn's Blinding Assault against the primary target, Vault, and Skystrike mark enemies hit with Harrier for 4 seconds, during which they are revealed.

core_mechanics.summary: Valor periodically marks enemies; specified damaging abilities apply revealing marks.

citations.quote: Quinn's next basic attack against a Harrier target consumes the mark to deal bonus physical damage.

core_mechanics.summary: A basic attack consumes a mark for bonus physical damage.

purpose: Recognize when Quinn threatens an empowered attack.
title: Harrier

citations.quote: Quinn sends Valor in the target direction who stops upon hitting an enemy, marking them with Harrier and dealing physical damage to all nearby enemies

core_mechanics.summary: Valor stops on an enemy, marks the primary target, and deals nearby physical damage.

citations.quote: The primary target is nearsighted briefly if they are a champion, and disarmed otherwise.

core_mechanics.summary: The primary target receives nearsight if a champion or disarm otherwise.

purpose: Recognize the projectile and its primary-target vision disruption.
title: Blinding Assault

citations.quote: Whenever Quinn uses a basic attack on-attack against a target marked by Harrier or consumes their mark, she gains bonus attack speed and bonus movement speed for 2 seconds.

core_mechanics.summary: Marked attacks or mark consumption grant brief attack speed and movement speed.

citations.quote: Valor grants sight of the surrounding area for 2 seconds and reveals enemy champions within for the same duration.

core_mechanics.summary: The active scouts the surrounding area and reveals enemy champions within.

purpose: Recognize her speed window and local reveal.
title: Heightened Senses

citations.quote: Quinn will track the target if they change locations.
She will dash to the target's previous location without applying Vault's effects if the target is too far away or moves beyond 1200 units.

advanced_exceptions.summary: Vault can track target movement, but sufficiently distant targets can escape its effects.

citations.quote: Vault's bounce's can vary to allow Quinn to close or to make a gap between herself and the target (depending on casting position) or even to jump through a wall (if there is enough landing room on the other side).

advanced_exceptions.summary: Bounce positioning can vary and can cross walls when landing space permits.

citations.quote: Quinn dashes to the target enemy, dealing physical damage, knocking them back, marking them with Harrier, and briefly slowing them. She then leaps backward.

core_mechanics.summary: A targeted dash damages, knocks back, slows, and marks the enemy before a backward leap.

citations.quote: Vault resets Quinn's basic attack timer shortly after the initial dash.
briefly interrupting it

core_mechanics.summary: Vault briefly interrupts the target and resets Quinn's attack timer.

purpose: Recognize her interrupt, spacing change, and marked attack setup.
title: Vault

citations.quote: Behind Enemy Lines is not a movement channel, and so will not be interrupted by root and ground.

advanced_exceptions.summary: Root and ground do not interrupt the initial channel; the flight-ending rule applies after uniting.

citations.quote: If Quinn uses Vault while Behind Enemy Lines is active, Skystrike will activate at her target's location after she bounces back.

advanced_exceptions.summary: Vault-triggered Skystrike occurs at the target's location after the bounce.

citations.quote: Quinn channels for a short time to pair up with Valor. They then become united, increasing her movement speed and becoming ghosted.

core_mechanics.summary: A channel prepares fast movement with Valor.

citations.quote: Declaring a basic attack or casting Blinding Assault or Vault during Behind Enemy Lines automatically activates Skystrike.
Quinn detaches from Valor, ending Behind Enemy Lines' effects and raining arrows down around her, dealing physical damage to nearby enemies and marking them with Harrier.

core_mechanics.summary: Combat actions trigger Skystrike, ending flight with nearby physical damage and marks.

citations.quote: The duo lose the movement speed boost upon taking non-minion damage, and disband upon being immobilized, grounded, or silenced.
without performing Skystrike

core_mechanics.summary: Non-minion damage suppresses the speed boost; immobilization, grounding, or silence ends flight without Skystrike.

purpose: Recognize fast roaming and the transition from flight into combat.
title: Behind Enemy Lines and Skystrike
